source.title: SGLT2 Inhibitors in Acute Heart Failure: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

schema_gaps: The schema has no dedicated systematic-review pooled-result or meta-analysis atom kind; pooled review findings use existing quantitative_result/adverse_event kinds with meta_analysis tags.
The schema has no heterogeneity field; I2 values are retained in canonical statements, original_result_text, and tags.
extraction_limitations: This is a secondary systematic review/meta-analysis. Trial-level results reported by the review remain secondary evidence and are not represented as if the review enrolled participants.
No separate supplement was present in the source packet.
The review contains internal numerical/reporting inconsistencies; these are preserved as separate atoms and in SEA appraisal rather than silently repaired.
